definitions.explanation: Legs that bow outward, or a way of walking with the knees and toes turned out.

examples.japanese: がに{股|また}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧がに{股|また}だ。

{子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→頃：32850_koro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧がに{股|また}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気|き}になって→気になる：03027_kininaru⟧⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧、⟦{歩|ある}き{方|かた}→歩き方：28428_arukikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{直|なお}そうとして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I have been bothered by my bowlegged walk since I was a child, and I am trying to change the way I walk.

notes:
USAGE:
- Mildly unflattering. Said to come from ⟦{蟹|かに}→蟹：04325_kani⟧ (crab), from the crab's splayed legs.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {内股|うちまた}: walking pigeon-toed, the opposite
- O⟦{脚|きゃく}→脚：30419_kyaku⟧ (オーきゃく): bowlegs, as a shape of the legs (the usual word in health and beauty contexts)
